name: ernestdefoe/masthead
description: Masthead — a portal theme for Flarum 2 in the style of IPS 5 and XenForo UI.X. A navy masthead, a featured-story hero, a tag grid, latest discussions and sidebar widgets, with named presets and a dark mode.

suggest.flarum/tags: The Browse the forum grid, the tag chips and a tag as the hero source.
suggest.flarum/sticky: Sticky discussions as the hero source.
suggest.fof/upload: Images attached with fof/upload are used as hero pictures.
suggest.ernestdefoe/page-builder: Page Builder articles as the hero source.
suggest.ernestdefoe/header-nav: Masthead draws the main navigation from Header Nav when it is installed.
suggest.ernestdefoe/backdrop: An author's profile cover is the hero picture of last resort.
suggest.ernestdefoe/picks: An upcoming-games widget in the portal sidebar.
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: Place Masthead's widgets anywhere fof/forum-widgets-core can.

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
